task_title: MCP SSE query references a processed column absent from the events schema
task_criteria: src/mcp/sse.ts must not query a nonexistent column: add the processed column via migration (default 0, with index) or change the query to a column that exists, so the SSE poll loop cannot throw SQLITE_ERROR. A test must cover the poll query against a freshly migrated DB.

items.criterion: src/mcp/sse.ts must not query a nonexistent column: add the processed column via migration (default 0, with index) or change the query to a column that exists, so the SSE poll loop cannot throw SQLITE_ERROR. A test must cover the poll query against a freshly migrated DB.
items.detail: The query is kept and the schema now provides the column: src/mcp/sse.ts:236 still runs `SELECT * FROM events WHERE timestamp > ? AND processed = 0 ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 10`, and migration v2 `add_events_processed` at specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.ts:174-183 executes `ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN processed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;` plus `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_processed_timestamp ON events(processed, timestamp);` (default 0 + index, as required). src/db/migrations.ts is a symlink to that file (`ls -la`: `src/db/migrations.ts -> ../../specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.ts`), and the compiled artifacts specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.js:164-168 and dist/specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.js:164-168 carry the same block, so the runtime path actually loads it. The migration flows through the existing gate `if (migration.version > currentVersion)` (migrations.ts:196-215), so both fresh and existing v1 DBs get the column. Test coverage: tests/mcp.test.ts:184-227 "polls unprocessed events after a fresh database migration" opens a fresh SpecLangDB, calls db.initialize(), asserts `SELECT id, processed FROM events` does not throw (line 188-189), inserts two events, sets one to processed=1, drives the private pollChanges() via pollSSEManager (lastPollTime=0), and asserts exactly one write containing src/changed.ts and not src/created.ts. Command evidence: `npx vitest run tests/mcp.test.ts tests/db.test.ts` -> "Test Files  2 passed (2) / Tests  68 passed (68)"; targeted run `npx vitest run tests/mcp.test.ts -t "polls unprocessed events"` -> "Tests  1 passed | 32 skipped (33)". RED proof I produced myself: deleting the version-2 block from specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.js makes the new test fail with `SqliteError: no such column: processed` at tests/mcp.test.ts:188 (restored afterwards; `git status --porcelain specs/ tests/` clean). Full suite `npx vitest run` -> "Test Files  1 failed | 98 passed | 4 skipped (103) / Tests  1828 passed | 65 skipped (1893)", the single failure being tests/ci/ci005-precommit-hook.test.ts ("Hook not found: .../.git/hooks/pre-commit") which is unrelated to this change. `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0. [resolution 0.22; src/mcp/sse.ts]
